name: caffeinate
description: Prevent the system from sleeping on behalf of a utility

options.name: -d
options.description: Create an assertion to prevent the display from sleeping

options.name: -i
options.description: Create an assertion to prevent the system from idle sleeping

options.name: -m
options.description: Create an assertion to prevent the disk from idle sleeping

options.name: -s
options.description: Create an assertion to prevent the system from sleeping. This assertion is valid only when system is running on AC power

options.name: -u
options.description: Create an assertion to declare that user is active.

options.name: -t
options.description: Specifies the timeout value in seconds for which this assertion has to be valid. The assertion is dropped after the specified timeout.

options.name: -w
options.description: Waits for the process with the specified pid to exit. Once the the process exits, the assertion is also released.
